name: Hirevire
description: Hirevire automated video screening platform. Nov 2025 stats: $7,375 MRR (+1.74% MoM), $486 avg lifetime value, ARPU $62.89. Building in public since 2023.

name: Senja
description: Senja is a testimonial collection platform. August buildinpublic report: hit $76,000 MRR, added $4,000 net MRR. Social proof marketing tool.

name: TrustMRR
description: Marc Lou's TrustMRR: a simple website listing MRR stats. Reached $18K MRR overnight by selling ad spots. Solo founder, launched in days. Also runs DataFa.st ($10K MRR) and CodeFa.st.

name: Refgrow
description: Refgrow is a platform helping SaaS companies launch affiliate and referral programs. Solo founder, 2.5 years to hit $1,000 MRR. Painfully slow but steady growth.

name: Pallyy
description: Pallyy is a social media scheduling tool. Solo founder Tim Bennetto taught himself to code, grew Pallyy to $74K MRR / $1.2M annual revenue with a 3-person team serving 60,000+ users worldwide.

name: twk93的一人公司
description: 2025一人公司年度总结，从0到200$/月。独立开发者，做了约两年半，平均一天4小时。成本：域名$50/年，海外电话卡$5/月，Cursor $20/月。核心优先级：市场营销 > SEO优化 > 产品迭代。

name: 独立开发者导航站 (IndieTools)
description: 独立开发者导航站，收录产品和工具信息。盈利模式尚未确定，考虑Affiliate联盟营销或Buy me a coffee赞助。包含产品工具、指南教程、独立应用三大板块。

name: HamsterBase
description: HamsterBase是一款本地优先的稍后读工具。2023年收入$400 USD。支持iOS、Android、Windows、Linux、Mac及Docker六个平台。计划部署离线AI embedding服务。

name: 做了十多款赚钱产品的独立开发者
description: 即刻上一位独立开发者做了十多款赚钱产品，通过分散风险（不同产品放不同平台/市场）实现财务自由。具体产品名未披露，但策略值得参考。

name: PNG部落 (AI生图工具站)
description: 独立开发者用Cursor+Supabase+Vercel，48小时上线AI生图工具站。第一个月零投放收入5000元，利润率86%。核心逻辑：不堆功能，只解决一个具体问题（国内用户快速AI生图）。

name: Marc Lou / TrustMRR (中文报道)
description: 独立创作者Marc Lou上线TrustMRR网站，仅5天靠卖广告位收入$18K。展示了indie hacker利用buildinpublic快速变现的路径。

name: まみそ Web制作AIアシスタント
description: Web制作者向けのAIコーディングアシスタントを開発し、月間数百万円の収益を達成。フリーランサー出身の経験を活かし、現場のニーズに密着したツール開発で成功。

name: Skeb (イラストコミッションサービス)
description: Skebは開発者なるがみ氏が1人で開発・運営していたイラストコミッションサービス。2018年11月リリース、2023年7月に実業之日本社に約10億円で事業売却。月間取引高6億円。

name: Peing -質問箱-
description: 2017年リリース、せせり氏がわずか6時間で開発。匿名質問サービスが爆発的に拡散し、3週間で1日800万PV以上を記録。その後Jiraffe社に推定数億円で買収。

name: Inkdrop (Markdownノートアプリ)
description: TAKUYA氏（devaslife）が開発したMarkdownノートアプリ。月額サブスクリプションで月15万円以上の安定収益。デスクトップ・モバイル対応の高品質アプリを1人で開発・運営。
topics: クロスプラットフォーム

name: 文字数カウントメモ
description: takashi氏が開発。テキストの文字数をリアルタイムカウントするシンプルなアプリ。累計70万ダウンロード、広告収入で累計700万円以上の売上。「ニッチ×圧倒的シンプルさ」が成功要因。

name: Tacboard (Event Photo Sharing SaaS)
description: Profitable SaaS for event photo sharing. $18K annual revenue, $10.8K profit, 59% margins. Minimal owner time required, strong growth potential. Vetted listing on Flippa.

name: Bustinger (YouTube Moderation SaaS)
description: High-margin SaaS with 70% profit margin. $6K annual revenue, 2% churn rate. Custom tech for YouTube moderation. Lean, growing, ready to scale.

name: Unnamed SaaS ($619K TTM Revenue)
description: Successful SaaS business with TTM $619K revenue and $168K ARR. Vetted Flippa listing. Ideal opportunity for growth-minded entrepreneurs looking for an established business.

name: Auto-Pilot SaaS ($200K Annual Revenue)
description: Thriving SaaS business with $200K annual revenue, 28% profit margin. Mostly running on auto-pilot for last 2 years. Huge upside if operated properly.

name: Postiz (Open Source Social Media Scheduler)
description: Nevo built Postiz, an open source SaaS for social media scheduling. 25K+ GitHub stars, $17K MRR. Demonstrates the open source monetization playbook in 2026.

name: Plausible Analytics
description: Open source, privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics. $1M ARR with 7,000+ paying subscribers, tracking 50,000+ websites. Built sustainable open source business.

name: 100xagenticdev DevTools SaaS
description: Developer tools and API SaaS opportunities 2026 guide. Cursor hit $2B ARR in Feb 2026. AI coding tools generated $12.8B revenue in 2026. Solo founder stack costs under $500/month.

name: Viktor.com (AI Coworker)
description: An AI coworker that actually does the work. Featured on Product Hunt trending. AI agent for business process automation and task execution.

name: フリーランスエンジニアの個人開発収入戦略
description: フリーランスエンジニア向け個人開発収益化ガイド。プロダクト型(SaaS)、スキル販売型(テンプレート)、コンテンツ型(技術書/Zenn/Udemy)の3モデル比較。Zenn本500円で月数千円〜5万円、Udemy講座で月15万円例。

name: Micro SaaS Benchmarks (BigIdeasDB)
description: BigIdeasDB tracks 8,699 SaaS startups, 3,787 reporting active revenue. Average $4,298 MRR, median $145 MRR, only 6.1% clear $10K MRR. Real revenue data from named micro SaaS companies.
